summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundle unrelated to the package's stated purpose
details: @servicetitan/carto-charts-core is advertised as an ECharts theme/charts library, but its package.json declares a preinstall script that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases and uses execFileSync to invoke that Bun binary against a bundled file named math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~728KB Bun-compiled JavaScript bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with rotated string-array obfuscation, `_0xNNNN` identifiers, and a decoder function (WV8StW) that unshifts a large numeric/string array to reconstruct strings. setup.mjs itself uses `_0xNNNN` identifiers and aliased indirection objects to obscure its control flow. The fetched alternate runtime is used to execute an opaque payload whose name (math_init) and content bear no relationship to an ECharts theme library, and execution occurs automatically on `npm install` before any consumer code runs. The Bun runtime is being used to bypass Node-based static analysis of the executed payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
